newsitem.title: USA: American Educational adopts plan vs takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: American Educational adopts plan vs takeover bid.

text.p: American Educational Products Inc said on Wednesday it declared a stock warrant dividend in response to a possible takeover threat.
The company said in a news release that one investor recently has acquired 30 percent of its outstanding shares.
This investor was not identified in the news release.

The warrant dividend allows shareholders of record as of Thursday, June 5, to receive a new warrant for every share they hold, entitling them to buy an additional share at an exercise price of $10 per share.
American Educational shares closed up 2/16 to 5-1/16 on Wednesday.
